requirements.text: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* 3-5 years of software engineering experience building production-grade systems
* Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP, cloud-native architecture, and infrastructure as code (Terraform)
* Experience with deploying scalable cloud-native applications to production
* Knowledge of agentic frameworks for multi-agent orchestration (e.g. LangChain, Google ADK)
* Experience with data orchestration, vector database management, and data evaluations to optimize usage with LLMs
* Proficiency with modern programming and scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, TypeScript)
* Experience with containerization (EKS/ECR), APIs development, and modern development tools (GitHub, Jira)
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with technical and business partners

We are seeking a full-stack software engineer with AI expertise to help design and deliver modern, cloud-native agentic AI solutions. This role sits within our core systems team and partners closely with engineers, architects, data scientists, and product teams to build scalable, secure, and highly available solutions leveraging AWS, GCP, APIs, DevSecOps, and AI. You will play a key role in advancing automation, developer productivity, and AI-enabled capabilities while contributing to enterprise standards and best practices.
* Experience in financial services, insurance, or wealth management Experience with LLM-based solutions and emerging AI technologies
* Experience in financial services, insurance, or wealth management Experience with LLM-based solutions and emerging AI technologies
* Relevant certifications in cloud, DevSecOps, or AI
